summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide integrated tooling for data preparation, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and monitoring at scale — unlike a simple model API, which only gives you inference against a pre-built model. You need a full platform when you train or fine-tune your own models, require governance and reproducibility, or must deploy and monitor models across large teams and workloads; a model API suffices when you only need inference from an existing foundation model. The landscape is dominated by the three hyperscaler platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML), followed by multi-cloud data+ML platforms like Databricks, AutoML-centric vendors like DataRobot and H2O.ai, and a new wave of developer-first infra tools like Weights & Biases and Modal.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/storage/endpoint hours; no upfront fees, with savings plans available
platforms.best_for: AWS-native teams developing and deploying custom models with deep control over the full ML lifecycle

platforms.name: Microsoft Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by underlying compute; no surcharge for the platform itself, enterprise agreements available
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem needing governance, responsible AI, and integration with Azure OpenAI

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by training/prediction node hours and per-token for generative models
platforms.best_for: Highly automated, state-of-the-art workflows and teams wanting tight access to Gemini and Google AI models

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based DBU pricing on top of cloud compute; tiered plans
platforms.best_for: Collaborative data science and heavy data engineering/ETL on a unified multi-cloud lakehouse

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Enterprises wanting automated model building and governed MLOps with minimal hand-coding

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free for individuals; team/enterprise subscription tiers per-user/usage
platforms.best_for: Teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and model lineage layered on any training stack

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; Driverless AI and enterprise platform via subscription/license
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting automated ML with strong explainability and open-source flexibility

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second compute billing; free monthly credits for new users
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting Python-native, serverless GPU infrastructure for training and deploying models without managing clusters

platforms.name: Hugging Face (Hub + Inference Endpoints + AutoTrain)
platforms.pricing: Free tier; Pro, Enterprise Hub, and pay-as-you-go Inference Endpoints by compute
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open-source transformers and deploying fine-tuned models quickly

platforms.name: Vertex AI competitor — ClearML
platforms.pricing: Open-source free tier; Pro and enterprise subscription tiers
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an open-source end-to-end MLOps stack with strong orchestration and GPU scheduling
